description: Pub de 36 s pour un vélo électrique pliable : accroche en mouvement, quatre arguments visuels, apogée en ville, plan calme final.

sortie.style: Cinematic urban dawn, anamorphic lens, teal and amber palette, soft haze, shallow depth of field

plans.resume: Vélo qui fonce dans une rue vide à l'aube
plans.prompt: Low tracking shot of a sleek folding electric bicycle speeding through an empty city street at dawn, rider in dark jacket blurred, long amber light streaks on wet asphalt
plans.camera: low tracking shot, fast forward motion

plans.prompt: Extreme close-up of hands folding a matte black bicycle frame in one smooth motion, metal hinge clicking shut, shallow depth of field, cool morning light
Close-up of a slim battery pack sliding out of a bicycle frame and glowing softly, held in a hand against a blurred office window
Wide aerial-style shot of a cyclist crossing a long steel bridge above a misty river, city skyline behind, sunrise breaking through haze
Medium shot inside a train carriage: a person lifts a folded bicycle onto the overhead rack, passengers blurred, warm interior light
Dynamic sweeping shot of a cyclist climbing a steep luminous street at golden hour, buildings rising on both sides, lens flare, dust in the air
plans.camera: sweeping crane rise following the rider

plans.prompt: Calm still shot of a folded bicycle tucked under a wooden desk, soft window light, plant in the corner, quiet end of day
plans.camera: static wide, very slow dolly back

musique: Pulsation électronique légère qui monte, apogée au deux tiers, retombée douce
